opennyai_summary.decision:
By way of the present revision petition, the petitioner is seeking setting aside of the order dated 07.09.2024, passed by the learned Trial Court and issuance of direction to the CBI to conduct thorough investigation in the FIR bearing no. 176/2024, registered at Police Station Mandawli Fazal Pur, for the commission of offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(f), 376AB of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter 'IPC') read with Section 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (hereafter 'POCSO Act'), against the accomplices, co-accused involved in the present case.
2. Arguments have been part heard on behalf of both the parties.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
In the meantime, the learned Trial Court is requested to adjourn the matter later than to a date fixed before this Court.
